cleaner.label: Terraform and Pulumi plugins
cleaner.description: Providers downloaded by Terraform and plugins downloaded by Pulumi, re-downloadable. Does not touch credentials, state or configuration.

option.label: Terraform provider cache
option.description: Removes the providers saved in the folder set by TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR.
option.warning: Providers are re-downloaded on the next `terraform init`: network required.

option.label: Pulumi plugins
option.description: Removes the provider plugins downloaded by Pulumi (plugins folder).
option.warning: Plugins are re-downloaded on the next `pulumi up` or with `pulumi plugin install`: network required.
